{% blocktrans trimmed %} We have recruited a large number of individuals working in the Swedish finance industry as, e.g., fund managers, finance analysts, or investment advisors. They have answered the same 25 investment problems that you have completed in task 1 and task 2 under the condition that they did it for a customer (i.e., a person from the adult working population in Sweden). {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} You can decide whether you want one of these financial professional to make the 25 investment decisions for you. If you do so, one of the financial professionals is assigned to you and his/her decisions are relevant for you: one of the 25 decisions made by him/her is paid out to you instead of your own decision made before. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} In case you prefer to delegate the decision to the financial professional, you have to indicate how much risk (on a scale from 1 to 4) the assigned professional should take on your behalf. The financial professionals are instructed to maximize your expected profit conditional on the risk level you indicate below. {% endblocktrans %}

{% if treatment == 'pro_flat' %} {% blocktrans trimmed %} For his/her decision on your behalf the financial professional receives a fixed payment 400 SEK. {% endblocktrans %} {% endif %} {% if treatment == 'pro_lin' %} {% blocktrans trimmed %} For his/her decision on your behalf the financial professional receives the same payment as you do. {% endblocktrans %} {% endif %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} If you do not want a financial professional to take the investment decisions for you, you stick to the 25 investment decisions you have taken before and are paid out accordingly. {% endblocktrans %}

{% endif %} {% if treatment == 'algo' %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} In this experiment, there exists a computer software (i.e., a robot-advisor) that can do all 25 investment decisions you have completed in task 1 and task 2 for a customer. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} You can decide whether you want the robot-advisor to make the 25 investment decisions for you. If you do so, the robot-advisor’s decisions are relevant for you: one of the 25 decisions made by it is paid out to you instead of your own decision made before. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} In case you prefer to delegate the decision to the robot-advisor, you have to indicate how much risk (on a scale from 1 to 4) the robot-advisor should take on your behalf. The robot-advisor is programmed in such a way that it maximizes your expected profit conditional on the risk level you indicate below. {% endblocktrans %}

{% blocktrans trimmed %} If you do not want the robot-advisor to take the investment decisions for you, you stick to the 25 investment decisions you have taken before and are paid out accordingly. {% endblocktrans %}

{% endif %}
